en/astral_text_1.transcript: Welcome. Lie down and let your bed carry all of your weight. The music will keep playing until you stop it. So, there is nowhere you need to be. If you drift into sleep at any point, that is perfectly fine.

en/astral_text_10.transcript: You may notice tingling, a soft hum, waves of warmth, or a sense of floating. These are simply signs of deep rest. Let them come and go and stay relaxed.

en/astral_text_11.transcript: Now imagine a second body made of soft blue light resting inside your physical body. With each breath out, it feels a little lighter.

en/astral_text_12.transcript: Let this body of light begin to float slowly like a feather lifted by warm air. Your physical body stays safe and heavy in your bed.

en/astral_text_13.transcript: Picture yourself drifting up toward the ceiling. Look down at the room softly, as if in a dream. There is nothing to do. Just float.

en/astral_text_14.transcript: If you like, drift on through the ceiling and out into a calm night sky. Feel cool, gentle air around you and the stars far above.

en/astral_text_15.transcript: Go wherever feels peaceful. Over quiet green hills, along a moonlit lake, or simply resting in the open sky. Let the journey unfold by itself.

en/astral_text_16.transcript: You are always safe. Your body rests in your bed, breathing slowly, and you can return to it with a single thought whenever you wish.

en/astral_text_17.transcript: My voice will grow quiet now. Keep floating. Explore or let yourself slip into deep sleep. Whatever happens next is just right.

en/astral_text_2.transcript: Take a slow breath in through your nose and let it go with a long, soft sigh. Once more, breathe in and let everything go. Now, let your breathing find its own easy rhythm.

en/astral_text_3.transcript: Bring your attention to your face. Let your forehead smooth out. Let your eyelids grow heavy and still. Unclench your jaw and let your tongue rest softly.

en/astral_text_4.transcript: Let your shoulders sink down away from your ears. Feel a warm heaviness flow down your arms, through your elbows and wrists, all the way to your fingertips.

en/astral_text_5.transcript: Notice your chest rising and falling by itself. Let your belly soften. With every breath out, your body settles a little deeper into the bed.

en/astral_text_6.transcript: Let the heaviness move down through your hips and legs, past your knees and ankles, into your feet. Your whole body is heavy, warm, and completely supported.

en/astral_text_7.transcript: Now, picture a wide, gentle staircase, leading down into a quiet, dimly lit room. Each step down lets you relax a little more deeply.

en/astral_text_8.transcript: Step down and sink deeper. Step down and let go a little more. Your body is drifting towards sleep, while a small part of your mind stays softly awake.

en/astral_text_9.transcript: At the bottom of the stairs, everything is calm. Your body is so heavy now that it seems to fall asleep on its own. Your mind rests, quiet and gently aware.
